description: Container and pallet load planner — Offline cube-and-weight load plan: how many cartons fit in a 20ft, 40ft, 40ft high-cube or 45ft container, a 53ft US trailer, or a US/EUR pallet. Give carton= LxWxH (cm; units=in for inches), optional weight= per carton (kg; weight_units=lb), container= (20ft, 40ft, 40hc, 45hc, 53ft, pallet-us, pallet-eur; default 40hc), this_side_up=yes to forbid tipping, and qty= to get units needed. Tries every allowed orientation plus a mixed floor split, applies the payload limit, and returns per-layer count, layers, utilization, weight- vs space-limited verdict and last-unit fill. Price: $0.004 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: logistics_load_plan
